title: Freya and the Homecoming
author: Ines Delacroix
blurb: Xanthe Nakamura, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
